headline: Xbox announces disc-to-digital feature that digitizes your physical games
summary: Xbox is launching a new disc-to-digital feature. It allows users to convert physical game collections. This supports game preservation for future consoles.

headline: Microsoft’s 25th anniversary Xbox will cost $899
summary: Microsoft's 25th-anniversary Xbox is priced at $899. Preorders start August 27th, with early access for some fans. The translucent green console launches November 13th.

headline: Elden Ring on the Switch 2 isn’t tarnished
summary: Elden Ring is coming to the Nintendo Switch 2. FromSoftware also plans to launch a new competitive multiplayer game, The Duskbloods. Switch 2 owners can experience this major hit.

headline: You can now buy music on SoundCloud
summary: SoundCloud has launched a new beta feature for direct music sales. Artists can now sell tracks directly from their profiles. This aims to better support musicians and simplify purchases.

headline: You Better Have The Space for LEGO's Longest Set Ever, The Star Wars Executor Super Star Destroyer
summary: LEGO has unveiled an enormous new Star Wars set. It's the Executor Super Star Destroyer. This model will be the company's longest ever.

headline: Exclusive: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Deluxe Edition - Mayhem Collection DLC Trailer Reveals The Joker and Harley Quinn Story Mission and More
summary: IGN exclusively revealed the LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight DLC trailer. The Mayhem Collection DLC features a new story mission with Harley Quinn and the Joker. It also includes Mayhem Mode and the Sinister Pack.

headline: Star Wars Zero Company Review
summary: Star Wars Zero Company receives an excellent review. It's praised as a tactical game. The game offers a cinematic feel similar to Star Wars Jedi titles.

headline: We’ve Seen The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in Action, and It’s Looking Like Another Blood & Wine | gamescom 2026
summary: We've seen The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in action. Geralt embarks on a new quest for his missing bard. The expansion is compared favorably to Blood & Wine.

headline: Video shows scale of flash flood hitting Nepal-Tibet border
summary: A video captures the immense scale of a flash flood. The flood impacted the Nepal-Tibet border region. The BBC edited the footage due to distressing content.

headline: Murder probe as two people dead in house fire in Middlesbrough
summary: Two people have died in a house fire in Middlesbrough. Cleveland Police launched a murder investigation. Police are not ruling out links to organized crime.

headline: Prince Harry and Meghan land in UK days after announcing move
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan have arrived in the UK. They landed privately with their two children. Their arrival follows days after announcing their move.

headline: Heart, hope and a steely determination: Dolly Parton's musical legacy
summary: Mark Savage reflects on Dolly Parton's musical legacy. The article highlights her irreplaceable impact. It praises her heart, hope, and determination.
